$description: English strings for the aircraft setup wizards, the flight flows, banners and controller settings. Keys are dotted; {name} is replaced by the argument of that name. Lookup falls back by dropping the last segment for setup.<step>.body.<variant|phase> (to setup.<step>.body); any other missing key renders the key itself.

strings.setup.accel.body: Place the aircraft in each pose shown, hold it still, then press Next pose.

strings.setup.ados_intro.body:
ADOS flies the aircraft: your sticks, skills and missions go through it, and it holds position, keeps height and avoids obstacles.
The flight controller still stabilises, mixes the motors and runs its own last-resort failsafe.
To take over, move any stick or press PS; to hand back to the flight controller, use the mode chip.
